   https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/ip_addresses/{ip_address}/communicating_files

   curl -X GET \
     "https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/ip_addresses/12.234.56.126/communicating_files?limit=10&cursor=pointer" \

     -H "Accept: application/json"

   The JSON will contain a `data` array with file objects and a `links` object that may include a `next` link with a new cursor if there are more results.
